displayRules: Never show the paper poster screenshot as the only schedule presentation.
Use text-first accessible HTML; no image-only schedule.
Keep times in America/New_York and make start/end times visually prominent.
Show live, virtual, turf and registration-required as distinct metadata.
For far-view mode restrict visible classes to four to avoid small text.
Retain current-month timestamp and clearly mark archived schedules.
Only the official YMCA site or an authorized manager can approve future schedule updates.
Do not imply real-time YMCA class reservations or instructor presence in the simulated environment.
Screens appear as non-executable website media inside authorized Worldweaver instances; access controlled by existing Worldweaver screen-cast rules.
